correctness.rationale: The exact vertex-toggle discrete Morse matchings are reconstructed and full acyclicity is verified for 170550,166002,20016 directed incidences, proving wedge homotopy types with critical positive cells 9x7,4x7,5x6. The intersection is a genuine simplicial subcomplex and attaching the omitted facet is a homotopy pushout with null map from wedge of S6 into wedge of S7; the split homotopy inclusion follows. Independent exact fixed-simplex and vertex-cycle Lefschetz sums agree on all 48 stabilizer elements; character inner products establish a sign line and a distinct irreducible 3-space. The source and expected output are packaged together; no finite result is generalized beyond the fixed objects.

value.rationale: A one-line deletion is the minimal canonical perturbation of the smallest thick generalized quadrangle incidence hypergraph. The new four-generator homotopy type, the five-sphere intersection and primitive split inclusion answer a natural relative-topology question and explain how the fifteenth line contributes to the nine global classes. The 1+3 stabilizer representation adds structural equivariant information unseen in ordinary Betti numbers; this is more than a straightforward numerical rank computation.
